title: Gold and the US dollar moving the same way on one day: continuation

rule.dxy: council/macro.mjs dxySeries: 50.14348112 x EURUSD^-0.576 x USDJPY^0.136 x GBPUSD^-0.119 x USDCAD^0.091 x (11.2/EURUSD)^0.042 x USDCHF^0.036 on folded daily closes
rule.signal: gold and dollar daily returns each beyond 0.5 x the sd of the 20 returns before the day, same sign
rule.costs: $0.60 a trade + nights() x FIN.xau.long on buys

tests.what: gold and the dollar both up > 0.5 sd: buy gold, hold 3 days (primary)
gold and the dollar both down > 0.5 sd: sell gold, hold 3 days
gold and the dollar both up > 0.5 sd: buy gold, hold 1 day
